title: A request whose client goes away runs to its end under its `wall_time`, or `disconnect_grace` when it has none, unless its method is listed in `cancel_on_disconnect`
divergesFromPhp: PHP-FPM learns of a closed tab at the script's next write and holds the worker until `max_execution_time`; here a request finishes as an output-buffered PHP page does in practice, without holding a worker, and a method can be set to cancel at the drop instead
